s01047.summary: Cullen, Dutch and Lupe watch a growing speck approach across the salt flat.
Dutch asks Cullen to unshackle him; Cullen refuses and Lupe grumbles.
Lupe tosses a canteen and the three share water while the speck nears.
The lone rider stops and raises a white cloth, and the group relaxes.

s01031.summary: Bertie and Lou trade taunts at the league finals while Hiro measures.
Lou's roll scatters Bertie's ball; Bertie cries cheat and Hiro rules it legal.
Skip rolls up and needles Bertie about her ninety-one losses.
Bertie takes the last ball and sends it to stop against the pallino.
Bertie wins amid uproar and sets a rematch with Lou.

s01081.summary: Rocco counts cash while Lena and Sal press nervous Timothy to put the bag down.
A floorboard creaks upstairs and Timothy flinches; Rocco calls it a dead possum.
The ceiling creaks again and a shadow moves; all four realize someone is up there.
Sal demands the bag; Timothy refuses, and Sal reaches toward his jacket.
Timothy admits he was forced and that the man upstairs sent him.
A silhouette descends the stairs and switches off the bulb, plunging the room into darkness.

s01071.summary: Adelaide stands gloved in the cold workshop as Tobias trims nothing in silence.
Adelaide dusts a lamp with her glove and needles Tobias about his rent.
A boy's voice outside prompts Adelaide to probe Tobias about his hired boy.
Adelaide finally sits; Tobias asks her to remove her gloves, but she will not.
They allude to her letter, which he burned, and he admits he knows.
Adelaide asks him to light a lamp on Fenchurch again and leaves.
Tobias takes down the dusty lamp and carefully wipes away her smear.

s01090.summary: Nell sits alone in the orchard with a radio and pears, numb.
Theo steps from the trees and awkwardly talks with guarded Nell.
Nell offers him a pear; they eat in silence and listen to a fragment of song.
A woman calls a name that is not hers and Nell calls it a girl she was.
Theo offers his hand and pulls Nell to her feet.
Mrs. Dunning appears at the orchard's edge, her face shifting between soft and hard.
Theo steps in front of Nell as Mrs. Dunning takes in the scene.
Mrs. Dunning walks back to the house, leaving the door open.
Nell and Theo gather the radio and pears and follow her, drawing closer.

s01023.summary: Paulina's crew waits out a breaker fault in the brine-smelling cannery.
Desmond shows Gus a video of his niece whistling, and Gus smiles.
A soft tapping from the live tank begins while Paulina counts missing cases.
Gus notes the tank water is perfectly still while the tapping continues from inside.
Paulina walks to the tank alone and wipes the glass.
A human hand presses the glass and a face with Gus's features floats up.
Gus, still on his bucket, smiles too wide as the lights go out.

s01084.summary: Rhee questions Osei beside the chalk outline in the drained pool.
Rhee lifts the tarp and finds a single red high heel.
Captain Voss phones to say a janitor witness is on her way.
Dolores Amadi descends the pool steps, mop in hand.
Dolores describes a tall man in gray and produces the second red shoe.
A clang sounds and a silhouette appears atop the diving board.
The silhouette leaps and Rhee, Osei and Dolores collide in a tangle as he escapes.
Dolores says she recognizes the coat.

s01058.summary: Barber Colter makes small talk while Magdalena lies under a hot towel.
Magdalena names Sheriff Haynes and points to his boots on the wall.
Colter notes she knows his name; she says it is on the window.
Magdalena asks where the sheriff is and says her brother sent him.
Colter backs away claiming to be only a barber as she opens her eyes cold.
The door opens behind him; Magdalena orders him to sit and tests the razor.

pd_sisters_2.summary: Kuligin and Tuzenbach discuss a benefit concert and Masha's piano talent.
Vershinin says the brigade may be transferred away, leaving the town empty.
Chebutikin drops the mother's clock and shrugs that nothing is certain.
Chebutikin blurts that Natasha has a romance with Protopopov and exits singing.
Vershinin recounts the fire and philosophizes about the fate of his daughters.

pd_dollhouse_6.summary: Helmer cannot accept parting and begs Nora to wait until tomorrow.
Nora dons cloak and hat, refusing to stay even as brother and sister.
Nora says goodbye, frees him of obligations, and returns his ring.
Helmer begs to write to her and help her, but she refuses all.
Nora says only a true wedlock would be the wonderful thing she no longer believes in.
Nora goes out through the hall.
Helmer sinks and calls her name, then a flicker of hope as the door shuts.

s01045.summary: Leonard attempts downward dog while goat Beyonce chews his sock.
Claudette's mother calls on speaker, interrogating her about goats, men and plumbers.
Beyonce bleats on cue and Claudette says she is proud of Leonard.
Claudette hangs up and resumes class with Warrior One.

s01087.summary: Hosea cranks the sluice as the barge rises in the canal lock.
Captain Ezekiel complains about delay; Hosea and Clementine answer back.
A rope snaps and the barge yaws; Clementine, Hosea and Perpetua scramble to steady it.
An officer on the towpath shouts for them to halt in the Crown's name.
Ezekiel, humbled, quietly orders Hosea to open the upper gate.
Hosea weighs his family and complies, cranking the upper sluice.
The barge shoots into the dark channel, leaving the officers behind.

s01025.summary: Fitch presides over lost property as mustached Barnaby and Aloysius enter.
Barnaby and Aloysius claim a trunk of shirts, with Aloysius mentioning papers.
Fitch produces the trunk containing shirts and a folio marked Mortimer.
Barnaby and Aloysius politely tangle over who signs first.
Hortense sweeps in with granddaughter Nell, looking for Sir Reginald.
Nell innocently confesses Grandmother wanted to meet the matching mustaches.
Fitch reveals the folio is a deed to the ship, sold repeatedly by the pair.
Barnaby and Aloysius bolt together and wedge in the doorway as a whistle blows.
Hortense announces they will buy the ship, ice cream notwithstanding.

s01057.summary: The night crew on the hospital barge checks beds, IVs and mops.
Mrs. Wray admits boredom and Linh reads the cracker box.
The horn sounds and the crew chats about docking and paperwork.
Mrs. Wray drifts off and Bronwen tucks her blanket, turning off the light.

s00014.summary: Counsel agree to admit the manifest and the judge moves to adjourn for lunch.
Lieutenant Arroyo enters carrying a sealed evidence bag.
Arroyo sets an engine-room ledger before the judge.
The judge asks Percy about the signature in the engineer's log.
De Luca and Osei clash over the ambush until the judge gavels order.
Percy whispers to De Luca, who goes pale and asks who Annabelle is.

s01067.summary: Abigail counts ice blocks and Tobias whittles in the cold ice house.
A stranger in a good coat asks for the master of the house.
Abigail questions the stranger, who claims to be a friend of the Ashworths.
He reveals himself as Rupert Ashworth, the supposedly dead heir.
Tobias rises with his knife and urges Abigail to stand behind him.
Rupert says he only wants the tin as the door creaks behind him.

s00011.summary: In a converted grain elevator office, Prudence uncaps a marker before her staff.
Prudence delivers empty jargon about insufficient synergy and writes it on the whiteboard.
Barnaby and Delphine's fingers touch over a pen and both look away.
A pigeon drops something near them; they decide to take it offline.
Barnaby shows a single-color pie chart as his deck, and Prudence praises it.
Barnaby and Delphine file to a broken elevator and wait facing steel.

s01048.summary: Dee-Dee hosts the night show as Roland and Cal drift in.
A dry-voiced caller requests Wild Horses for the three of them.
The caller says they can be seen, and the crew stiffens.
A flashlight clicks on in the dark field, aimed unmoving at the studio.
Dee-Dee keeps steady and plays the song; the flashlight goes out.

s00010.summary: Armed Dez keeps Oksana at the controls with a stopped car full of people.
Under Dez's gun Oksana tells Base everything is fine; Marguerite is suspicious.
Dez has Oksana send Marguerite home and tells her the clock is running.
Dez makes Oksana open the duffel, revealing a handcuffed steel case.
Ski patrol Tariq walks in on the standoff and is ordered to sit.
Dez asks who knows Tariq is there and rips his radio away.
Marguerite spots headlights; Oksana warns Dez she must answer or it's a hostage call.
Dez tells her to be truthful; Marguerite replies to move the car.
Oksana puts her palm on the lever and tells Dez he can still walk out.
Dez cocks the pistol and orders her to pull; she pulls and the cable runs.

s01088.summary: Bee and Bram haul the injured captain's stretcher across the mud.
Bee checks the captain's pulse; the tide is about to turn.
Bee orders Bram to drop the water jug for the captain's sake.
Bram falls and urges her to go on; Bee hauls him up.
The captain wakes and insists on crawling; they follow as water rises.

s01072.summary: Renata eats lunch contentedly in her hidden crawlspace above the office.
An intercom announces an audit of unoccupied workstations.
The intercom names her own empty desk and calls her to Facilities.
A flashlight sweeps behind her in the crawlspace and she whispers oh no.

s01109.summary: Billie tests the old scoreboard controls in the empty gym.
The janitor reminds her lights go off at ten; she asks for five minutes.
She lights a spotlight on empty center court and says tip off.
Billie runs the home score to 99 and sounds the horn, whispering good game.
She clicks off the spotlight and the scoreboard goes dark.
